in_sanskrit.name: Guman
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mighty, Powerful
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Guman एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘gu’ meaning 'heavy' or 'mighty' and ‘man’ meaning 'mind' or 'man', Guman signifies a powerful being or one with a strong mind. In Hindu mythology, Guman is an epithet of Lord Shiva, symbolizing his immense power and strength.
